meta.title: Femik — Web presence, automation and data for growing businesses
meta.description: A website that sells, processes that run on their own and data that guides decisions. Femik is the digital team for growing businesses.

suggest.text: This site is also available in English.

hero.h1: Web presence, automation and data working together for your business.
hero.lead: Femik puts your business in the right place online: a website that sells, processes that run on their own and numbers that show you the next step — all connected, without having to build an in-house tech team.

s1.title: Websites and landing pages that convert
s1.text: Fast, great on mobile and built to turn visits into leads. Your positioning is clear from the very first screen.

s2.title: Custom web apps
s2.text: Client areas, catalogs, booking, internal dashboards: custom web tools built around how your business actually runs.

s3.title: Workflow automation
s3.text: Forms that become proposals, orders that alert your team, reports that arrive ready to read. Less repetitive work, more time to sell.

s4.title: Data analysis and dashboards
s4.text: Sales, marketing and operations in one dashboard. Clear metrics so you decide based on numbers, not guesswork.

s5.title: Digital media and content
s5.text: Social media, ads and content aligned with your positioning — and measured in the same dashboard as your results.

about.title: The digital team your business doesn't have yet.
about.p1: Femik was born to solve a common problem: growing businesses hire one vendor for the website, another for social media, another for spreadsheets — and none of it talks to each other.
about.p2: We bring presence, automation and data together in a single method. Each delivery builds on the last, and you follow everything through simple metrics.
about.v3t: every project has a goal and a number

method.d1: we learn your business, your audience and where the bottleneck is.
method.d2: website and social media with clear positioning.
method.d3: we connect your tools and eliminate repetitive tasks.
method.d4: we measure, learn and start the cycle again with more precision.

testi.title: What changes when everything is connected.
testi.q1: The website form builds the quote instantly and alerts the team on WhatsApp. No request goes unanswered.
testi.q2: Sales, inventory and targets in one dashboard. Meetings start with the numbers, not opinions.
testi.q3: A new website, aligned social media and every client's source tracked, from first visit to signed contract.

contact.title: Your next digital step starts with a conversation.
contact.text: Tell us in a few lines what you need. We'll reply on WhatsApp with a free initial assessment.
